g.text: Nominal SMBUS communication in dma mode
Step 1: initializes the SMBUS and DMA instances.
Step 2: receives a buffer, from the controller, in a non-blocking mode using DMA.
Step 3: waits for the SMBUS interrupt: read transfer completed.
Step 4: transmits the received buffer in a non-blocking mode using DMA.
Step 5: waits for the SMBUS interrupt: write transfer completed.
reports the success status by turning on the status led.
